dialogues.jp:
「たまには愛情のこもった手作り弁当が食べた
　いよな……」
dialogues.en:
"I want to enjoy a lovingly-made lunchbox once in a
while..."
dialogues.text:
"I want to enjoy a lovingly-made lunchbox once in a
while..."

dialogues.jp:
手の平に載せた購買のパンをじっと見ながら、
一人ごちる。
dialogues.en:
Staring hard at the bread in my hands, which I had bought
earlier, I mumbled to myself.
dialogues.text:
Staring hard at the bread in my hands, which I had bought
earlier, I mumbled to myself.

dialogues.jp:
と、愛情｛・・／だけ｝こもったモノなら準備出来そうな
ことに気が付いて、内容を少し変更することに
した。
dialogues.en:
Compared to the pains one can go to make a lunchbox, the
actual contents of it don't matter as much.
dialogues.text:
Compared to the pains one can go to make a lunchbox, the
actual contents of it don't matter as much.

dialogues.jp:
「栄養も味も抜群でさ。食べるだけで、思わず
　泣いてしまいそうな奴を……」
dialogues.en:
"But in this case, taste and nutrition would take priority.
If I can't enjoy the love in food, I could enjoy the food
itself..."
dialogues.text:
"But in this case, taste and nutrition would take priority.
If I can't enjoy the love in food, I could enjoy the food
itself..."

dialogues.jp: 「てな訳で、くれ」
dialogues.en: "But man, I wish."
dialogues.text: "But man, I wish."

dialogues.jp:
ことりは苦笑しつつ、口の中に食べ物を入れて
くれた。
dialogues.en:
Kotori, with a relenting smile, let me have a spoonful of
her lunchbox.
dialogues.text:
Kotori, with a relenting smile, let me have a spoonful of
her lunchbox.

dialogues.jp: 「ん、さんきゅ。何？」
dialogues.en: "Mm, thank you. What was that?"
dialogues.text: "Mm, thank you. What was that?"

dialogues.jp: もぐもぐやりながら｛たず／訊｝ねる。
dialogues.en: I asked her while chewing it.
dialogues.text: I asked her while chewing it.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ダシ巻き玉子です。どうですか？」
dialogues.en: "An egg roll. How was it?"
dialogues.text: "An egg roll. How was it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん。美味いよ」
dialogues.en: "It was great."
dialogues.text: "It was great."

dialogues.jp: とりあえず、泣く真似をしてみせる。
dialogues.en: I pretended to shed a few tears of joy.
dialogues.text: I pretended to shed a few tears of joy.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ごほっ。自信作です」
dialogues.en: "*Cough* Good, I made it myself!"
dialogues.text: "*Cough* Good, I made it myself!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「俺もこんなのが毎日食えればな」
dialogues.en: "I wish I could eat this kind of thing every day."
dialogues.text: "I wish I could eat this kind of thing every day."

dialogues.jp:
パンの袋を開けながら、ため息をついてみせる。
いいパンがゲット出来ただけマシか……。
dialogues.en:
With a sigh, I open my packets of bread. I couldn't get any
of the good ones today...
dialogues.text:
With a sigh, I open my packets of bread. I couldn't get any
of the good ones today...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「作ればいいじゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "Couldn't you just make one yourself?"
dialogues.text: "Couldn't you just make one yourself?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……それは、夜空に浮かぶ星が綺麗だからっ
　て、取ってくればいいって言ってるのと同じ
　だな」
dialogues.en:
"...Under the beautiful stars of the night sky, that would
sound far more appropriate."
dialogues.text:
"...Under the beautiful stars of the night sky, that would
sound far more appropriate."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「その内、断頭台に送られるぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"Does that mean you're trying to escort me to the
guillotine?"
dialogues.text:
"Does that mean you're trying to escort me to the
guillotine?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……何の話ですか？」
dialogues.en: "...What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "...What are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「マリー・アントワネットだ。それと同じわが
　ままを、先の“作れ”発言には感じる」
dialogues.en:
"Marie Antoinette. That's the feeling I got from your
suggesting that I "make my own lunchbox", anyway."
dialogues.text:
"Marie Antoinette. That's the feeling I got from your
suggesting that I "make my own lunchbox", anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「別に、私はわがままじゃないじゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "I'm not so willful like that."
dialogues.text: "I'm not so willful like that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも、自分で作らないなら、家族の人は？」
dialogues.en:
"But if you can't make one yourself, what about the rest of
your family?"
dialogues.text:
"But if you can't make one yourself, what about the rest of
your family?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「別に、胃や舌をいじめる趣味はないんで」
dialogues.en:
"I don't particularly want to torture my stomach and
tongue."
dialogues.text:
"I don't particularly want to torture my stomach and
tongue."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……美味しくないんですか？」
dialogues.en: "...No one's a good cook in your family?"
dialogues.text: "...No one's a good cook in your family?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「前線に送り込まれた餓死寸前の兵士なら、　
　嫌々食べるかも」
dialogues.en:
"Even soldiers on the front lines, dying of starvation,
wouldn't eat what they would make."
dialogues.text:
"Even soldiers on the front lines, dying of starvation,
wouldn't eat what they would make."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、作ってもらったら、それはそれで嬉し
　いんでしょ……ごほっ、ごほっ」
dialogues.en:
"But didn't you say as long as they made it for you, you'd
be happy... *cough cough*"
dialogues.text:
"But didn't you say as long as they made it for you, you'd
be happy... *cough cough*"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Having a cold?"
dialogues.text: "...Having a cold?"

dialogues.jp:
前半の内容には、ノーコメントを決め込む。丁
度いい話のネタになったが、心配なのは確かだ。
dialogues.en:
I decided not to comment on the first half of what she said,
and fortunately the second half gave me the perfect chance.
dialogues.text:
I decided not to comment on the first half of what she said,
and fortunately the second half gave me the perfect chance.

dialogues.jp: 「何か、さっきから咳してるけど」
dialogues.en: "What's up with your coughing?"
dialogues.text: "What's up with your coughing?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん、そうですね。ちょっと、調子が悪い
　かも」
dialogues.en: "Uuuhn, I dunno. I haven't been feeling that well lately."
dialogues.text: "Uuuhn, I dunno. I haven't been feeling that well lately."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「季節の変わり目だしな。ちゃんと、早めに薬
　を飲んどいた方がいいぜ？　んで、夜はさっ
　さと寝る、と」
dialogues.en:
"It must be the change of seasons. Shouldn't you take some
cold medicine? And get plenty of rest at night, as well."
dialogues.text:
"It must be the change of seasons. Shouldn't you take some
cold medicine? And get plenty of rest at night, as well."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「風邪は引き初めが肝心だからな」
dialogues.en: "It's esssential to nip these things in the bud if you can."
dialogues.text: "It's esssential to nip these things in the bud if you can."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうかしたか？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「何だか、真面目な顔だなって思ったんです。
　朝倉君には珍しいくらいの」
dialogues.en:
"You're just being so serious... I haven't seen you this way
very often."
dialogues.text:
"You're just being so serious... I haven't seen you this way
very often."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、たまにはな」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's good once in a while."
dialogues.text: "Well, it's good once in a while."

dialogues.jp:
苦笑しつつ、パンにかぶりつく。ことりの方こ
そ真面目な顔で、俺の顔をじっと見つめていた。
dialogues.en:
I gave a slightly disatisfactory smile, and bit into my
bread. It was Kotori's turn to stare at my face with a
serious expression.
dialogues.text:
I gave a slightly disatisfactory smile, and bit into my
bread. It was Kotori's turn to stare at my face with a
serious expression.

dialogues.jp: 「だから、何だって」
dialogues.en: "Something on my face?"
dialogues.text: "Something on my face?"

dialogues.jp:
笑いながらそう言った。あんまり見つめられる
と、こそばゆいじゃないか。
dialogues.en: I try and joke about it to relieve my discomfort a little.
dialogues.text: I try and joke about it to relieve my discomfort a little.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃんも、大変ですよね」
dialogues.en: "I don't think "onii-chan" would work well..."
dialogues.text: "I don't think "onii-chan" would work well..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はあ？」
dialogues.en: "Haah?"
dialogues.text: "Haah?"

dialogues.jp:
唐突な台詞に、何と答えたものやら分からなく
なる。“お兄ちゃん”だって？
dialogues.en:
Her sudden words surprised the hell out of me. "onii-chan"
now?
dialogues.text:
Her sudden words surprised the hell out of me. "onii-chan"
now?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　それとも、兄さん、なのかな……？」
dialogues.en: "Mm? Then just "nii-san", maybe?..."
dialogues.text: "Mm? Then just "nii-san", maybe?..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あのぅ……何の話です？」
dialogues.en: "Uhm... what are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "Uhm... what are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ごめんなさい……こっちの話です」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I'm sorry... just ignore that."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I'm sorry... just ignore that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こっちって、どっち？」
dialogues.en: "No, what was that?"
dialogues.text: "No, what was that?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こっちは、こっちですよ」
dialogues.en: "Nothing, nothing really."
dialogues.text: "Nothing, nothing really."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah..."

dialogues.jp:
にっちもさっちも行かない会話に、何だか、パ
ンの味も分からなくなる。
dialogues.en:
With the conversation coming to a standstill, I go back to
my bread.
dialogues.text:
With the conversation coming to a standstill, I go back to
my bread.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ともかく、心配してくれてありがとさんです。
　早速、お薬買うことにしますね」
dialogues.en:
"In any case, thanks for your concern. I'd buy some cold
medicine at once."
dialogues.text:
"In any case, thanks for your concern. I'd buy some cold
medicine at once."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、それがいいよ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, that'd be good."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, that'd be good."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Oh, but..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, but..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「さっき、おかず、食べさせてあげたじゃない
　ですか」
dialogues.en: "I gave you a little from my lunchbox just now..."
dialogues.text: "I gave you a little from my lunchbox just now..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「もしかしたら……移っちゃうかもしれません
　ね」
dialogues.en: "You could be... infected by that, couldn't you?"
dialogues.text: "You could be... infected by that, couldn't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ま、だいじょぶでしょ。なんとかは風邪引か
　ないってな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it'd be okay. I'm not too affected by colds or
anything easily."
dialogues.text:
"Well, it'd be okay. I'm not too affected by colds or
anything easily."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それもそうですね」
dialogues.en: "I'd say so."
dialogues.text: "I'd say so."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何おう？」
dialogues.en: "What was that?"
dialogues.text: "What was that?"

dialogues.jp: ぐっと腕まくりしてみせる。
dialogues.en: I folded my arms across my chest.
dialogues.text: I folded my arms across my chest.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「冗談ですよ」
dialogues.en: "Just a joke!"
dialogues.text: "Just a joke!"

dialogues.jp: くっくと笑い──ことりは、咳をしたのだった。
dialogues.en: In the midst of giggling, Kotori started coughing.
dialogues.text: In the midst of giggling, Kotori started coughing.

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりが風邪？◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori's Catching a Cold?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori's Catching a Cold?◆

dialogues.jp: ことりと一緒に昼食を取る。
dialogues.en: i had lunch together with Kotori.
dialogues.text: i had lunch together with Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは何だか風邪気味らしく、ちょっと心配
だった。
dialogues.en:
Kotori appeared to be down with the cold, worrying me a fair
bit.
dialogues.text:
Kotori appeared to be down with the cold, worrying me a fair
bit.
